My dear [Edmund](/person/42),
Here is an entreaty I have had from [Mary](/person/28). I can’t worry the old [Warden](/person/1304), and I don’t know what niece is with him.[^2] I don’t think there is much to see extra at New College, but would you send her a note to make it possible. I think one sees the Hall naturally, and there was not much in the Library to see, but I suppose William of Wykeham’s staff is only shewn by special favour
Your affec

C M Yonge


[^1]: The Rev.

Edwards Sewell, Warden of New College, Oxford, lived with his sister Janetta until the latter’s death in July 1890.
[^2]: CMY\'s correspondent, probably Mary Anderson Morshead, evidently solicits entry to New College, Oxford, and its archives.

As a former fellow of New College and a schoolmaster at Winchester, Morshead would have had the necessary connections.
